GuardEntry.description: A guard a transition names (ADR-0054 decision 2).

ref.description: The guard: its bare id in the same pack, or <pack>::guard:<id> in another pack.
ref.title: Ref

config.description: The entry's configuration, checked at load against the guard's config_schema; its content is open (ADR-0042 S4 as amended).
config.title: Config

blocking.description: Whether a failing guard blocks this transition (absent means true) or only reports.
blocking.title: Blocking

GuardEntry.title: GuardEntry

terminal.description: Whether the state ends the machine: no transition leaves it.
terminal.title: Terminal

StateId.description: A state id: lower case, words joined by an underscore or a hyphen (core's lane names are snake_case). A word a YAML 1.1 reader takes for a boolean or null is refused, so every reader reads the same id.
StateId.title: StateId

from.description: The state the transition leaves: one state, a list of states, or * for every non-terminal state other than the transition's target (ADR-0050 decision 17 as annotated).
from.title: From

event.description: The triggering event, a free token the client interprets (ADR-0050 decisions 8 and 17, the key renamed from on by the operator on 2026-11-02, since a YAML 1.1 reader takes a plain on key for true). A word a YAML 1.1 reader takes for a boolean or null is refused.
event.title: Event

YamlWord.description: A word a YAML 1.1 reader takes for a boolean or null (core reads packs with one, so an id of this word would be read as true, false or null there).
YamlWord.title: YamlWord

description: A declared, reusable state machine (ADR-0050 decision 17): states, an initial state and transitions, each transition guarded by guard artifacts (ADR-0054). A mission step runs it as a submachine; the client runs and enforces it.

id.description: The lifecycle's id, kebab-case; it is the file stem.
id.title: Id

title: Lifecycle
